wcez5c:318: The article recommends “pre-warming 10–15 minutes before the training and setting the capacity to 1.1 times the expected number of trainees,” and there is concrete engineering logic behind this. The Auto Scaling mechanism of WorkSpaces Applications adjusts based on waiting time: when user requests arrive in bursts, the Fleet triggers a scaling-out process, but the speed of scaling-out is limited by instance startup time (about 1–2 minutes). In the first 5 minutes of a training session, if 50 trainees click the link at the same time and the Fleet's initial capacity is 0, the system needs to quickly create and pre-warm instances within 1–2 minutes, which may cause the first few trainees to encounter a queue. The strategy of pre-warming to 55 (1.1 times) ensures sufficient buffer capacity at the start of a session; Auto Scaling continues to scale out in the background, and trainees do not experience noticeable waiting.
